notes: Lactose-free milk (k5) merged into Cow's milk as a type; hay-milk TSG entries became types (cow, goat). Cow's milk cut from 30 SKUs to 12: national leaders from the old data plus Arla's Cravendale and Lactofree (sourced from the Cravendale Wikipedia page). Dropped regional/retailer/single-farm SKUs (Al Ain, Al Rawabi, Amul Calci+, Bio-Heumilch, Haleeb, Arokya, Junlebao, K-Classic, Milma, Killadoon, Verka x2, Schwarzwaldmilch, Wright Family Dairy, Thüringer Land, Vita, Yotsuba, New KCC Gold Crown x2, Alquería). Lactalis has a brand entry, but no liquid-milk model was confirmed on a retrieved page, so it has no model. No independent milk test winner was sourced. Yoo-hoo is mainly water, sugar and whey (per its Wikipedia page) but kept as the archetypal US chocolate drink. Powdered flavoured mixes (Nesquik, Milo, Horlicks) were left out as mixes rather than milk drinks. Camelicious founding year and Desert Farms country were not stated on the retrieved pages.
